rows.en: A quote records the currency the body named. The record will not assume one, so say which currency the amount was quoted in.

rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The currency or the stated basis is too long, or holds a quotation mark, a backslash or a line break, which the record cannot store. Shorten it or leave those characters out.

rows.en: No proposed passage or connection you can see goes by that name, so nothing was accepted.

rows.en: A reading of a response is one of: complied, partial, denied, or none (nothing came back in time). Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: escalation's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A determination records what was required, what was done, and why, and never what should be done. Propose an action instead. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The law a records request is made under is named by its citation, a short reference such as a code section, and only a records request carries one. rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: reevaluation's translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: case-disclosures' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A reminder is set on a deadline of the action that has a date, for a day written year-month-day; it changes or removes only a reminder of your own; it is not set twice on one day; and an action holds at most 50 reminders. This request did not meet one of those, so nothing was changed.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-clocks' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This move says how the action ended while moving it somewhere that is not an ending. Recording an outcome the action has not reached would put a result in the record before there is one.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A reading of none says nothing came back in time, so it names no reply. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: escalation's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This vendor keeps some of the files it is sent for its own research. Confirm that you accept that before it is added. Nothing was added.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The team has retired this material, recording that it is superseded or no longer stands, so a citation made now would read to everyone after you as live support nobody will look at again. rows.note: DEC-260: citation's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This change says the item was made at a different time than the record holds. A change can alter what a document says, but not when it was made: the record orders its history by that date, and letting a later change move it would let anyone backdate something. Nothing was written. Send it again with the date the record holds, or with none.
rows.note: DEC-260: promotion's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This change says the item was produced by a different team than the record holds. A change can alter what a document says, but not whose it is: the record keeps who produced each thing so it can be held to account, and letting a later change move that would let anyone re-attribute it. Nothing was written. Send it again with the team the record holds, or with none.
rows.note: DEC-260: promotion's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This change would turn something the record already holds into a different kind of thing, an item of information into an action, say. A change can alter what a document says, but not what it is, because what it is decides which rules protect it. Nothing was written. To record it as the other kind, create a new one of that kind and link the two.
rows.note: DEC-260: promotion's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A proposed risk tier carries its basis: what the proposer read the tier from, in its own words, kept beside the proposal. The basis was missing, longer than 500 characters, or held a quotation mark, backslash or line break, which this record cannot store. Nothing was written, and the action's tier was never going to change.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This action's record of earlier risk tiers is not in a shape the act can add to without rewriting it, and the act only ever adds. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Changing a risk tier needs a reason, and it is kept beside the change for as long as the record lasts. The reason was missing, longer than 500 characters, or held a quotation mark, backslash or line break, which this record cannot store. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A risk tier is 1 (file freely), 2 (file with caution) or 3 (do not file without counsel), or it is left unstated, which reads as not assessed. This write stated something else, so nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: After an action is created, its risk tier changes only through the risk-tier act, which records who changed it, when and why, and keeps every earlier tier readable. This write would have changed the tier, or the record of its earlier tiers, some other way, so nothing was written. Use the risk-tier act.
rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: What material does for an answer is a property of a question's basis, and the thing citing here is a case. A case's citation carries no such part, so this one would be dropped rather than recorded — and a field stated in one place and honored nowhere is how a record and the pages built from it drift apart.
rows.note: DEC-260: citation's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Each standard is compared in rows: what it requires, what was done, and whether the two align, diverge or are open. A standard has no row, or a row is missing a part. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The record's rule services are switched off in your team's Civicsmith until the assistant's measured bar is met. Nothing was read.
rows.note: DEC-260: answers' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A rule service of that name is already held; the first one stays. Nothing was changed.
rows.note: DEC-260: answers' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: No rule service of that name is held in your team's Civicsmith. Nothing was read.
rows.note: DEC-260: answers' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The investigation this names has ended, and an ended investigation reads and proposes nothing more: its work is read against the conditions it ran under, and those stopped when it stopped. Nothing was done.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The safe copy of this file could not be made. The tool's reason is stated beside it. The original is unchanged.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The safe copy of this file is being made. Ask again shortly.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The safe view of this file could not be made. The reason is stated beside it. The original is unchanged.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This file is high risk, so it opens as its safe view. A deeper check that passes opens the original to every member for a day, or you can open it after the warnings.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The safe view of this file is not made yet. It is made soon after a file is captured; ask again shortly.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: You already asked to release this hold. A second, different member has to agree before it is released.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The file scanner your team's Civicsmith uses did not answer, so nothing was scanned and no note was written. It is asked again on its next round.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A scanner reported a finding in this file, so its original is held and does not open. The safe view still opens, and the file keeps its place in the record. Two members can release the hold, each with a reason, or a second, different scanner can clear it in a deeper check.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This file is being scanned before it opens. Ask again in a moment; the safe view can be read meanwhile.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This high-risk file was last found clean more than a week ago, and the scanner cannot check it again now, so the original was not opened. Show the safe view, or ask for a deeper check.
rows.note: DEC-260: file-safety's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A records request may name the stages it asks the records for: one to twelve different entries, each naming a progression, an entity and a stage in at most 200 characters each, and each stage one its progression declares. rows.note: DEC-260: action-grammar's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A document acknowledged as self-attested only is either co-attested already or not one this case rests on, so it needs no acknowledgment. Remove it from the list. Nothing was written.

rows.note: DEC-260: case-disclosures' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A determination records whether the act complied, not how much it matters. Significance, severity, priority, urgency, rank and score are members' judgments made with the consequences in front of them. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The owners have already been asked to sign this edition, and it is in their queues. Nothing was written. The answer shows who asked and when.
rows.note: DEC-260: tasks' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: promotion's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This source of proposals is already registered. A source registers once, when your team's Civicsmith starts.

rows.en: Actions are attached at notification, legal tools and political accountability. The escalation's stage now takes none. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: escalation's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This standard does not bind this body, so the act cannot be found nonconforming against it. Record it as a benchmark comparison: below, slower than, or above. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A standard named was not in force when the act was done, by the period the record states for it. An act is measured against the standards that applied to it. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Name which side of the question states what the standard requires, a or b. Your team's Civicsmith never chooses it. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This standing question has ended, and an ended question is never started again. Set a new one if you want it to keep running. Nothing was changed.
rows.note: DEC-260: answers' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A standing question needs an end date after today, so it does not run for ever. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: answers' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A standing question keeps one search: a saved search, or a find in a document, a set or a project. Give one of these, not both. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: answers' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: That is not a move this item can make from where it stands. Each kind of thing has a set of moves its rules allow, and this one is not among them, so nothing was written. Move it by a step the rules allow, or leave it where it stands and record what changed.

rows.en: This work is already an open step on the question. Use that step, or add your question to it. Nothing was written.

rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A cost is a fee or a purchase: an exact amount, its currency's three-letter code, and what it paid for. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: An outcome is helped, a dead end, or not yet judged, recorded for a question the step is on. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A step is taken on one or more questions, in one project, or for the whole team: exactly one of these, and a step is never placed inside another step. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Name what the step produced by the record's own id: a record, a capture, a passage, a lead or a derived connection with its derivation. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A reminder is set for a calendar day. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Write it in your own words, within the length it allows. Nothing was written, and nothing was cut.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A step waits on another step, on something arriving, or on a date. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: promotion's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The system never judges whether a step helped or was a dead end; a member does. It ends its own step with every outcome not yet judged, or sets it aside with its reason. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Only a member does this, in their own words and by their own choice. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A part of your team's Civicsmith tried to add its own check to every promotion without naming itself, so nothing was registered. This is a fault in how your team's Civicsmith was built, not in the record, and nothing in the record changed.
rows.note: DEC-260: promotion's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This step is a project's own, and a question's use of it would show it beyond that project. Take a step on the question instead. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A step is work done toward an answer, never part of what a finding rests on. Rest the finding on what the step found. Nothing was written.

rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This names a step the work serves, and the step could not be read here, so nothing was tied to it. Nothing was proposed.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This step waits on something not yet met, named here. It starts once each wait is met or removed. Nothing was written.

rows.en: This wait would close a loop: the steps named would each wait on the other and none could start. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This step would wait on a step fewer people can see, so some who see it could not see what it waits on. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Work was done on this step, so its record is kept. Set it aside instead. Nothing was deleted.
rows.note: DEC-260: steps' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: filings' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A detector looks at money facts, contracts and patterns over facts, never at a person; this definition names a person. Nothing was defined.
rows.note: DEC-260: money-checks' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A field this reading has to fill in carries filler text rather than an account of anything. A required field filled to get past a check is worse than an empty one, because it reads to the next member as something somebody wrote.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Two parts of this reading are offered as separate routes to the same answer, and the record can show they trace back to the same original material. Treating them as separate makes the answer look better supported than it is, so a machine may not put it forward that way; a member may still say they are genuinely separate, and that is their call to sign for.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The record holds more material behind this question than could be checked in one pass, so whether this reading is genuinely new, or genuinely made of separate parts, was not settled either way. Not finishing the check is a different fact from passing it, and this record does not let the two read the same.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Reporting that a level of the search is empty means saying WHICH level was searched and where the log of that search can be read. Absence at one level is not absence at the next, and an unattributed empty answer is the one shape nobody can check.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: One of the pieces of evidence this reading rests on cannot be reached where it says it is: it is not in the record, it cannot be read from here, or the record has retired it. A reading resting on something retired reads to a later member as live support for the answer.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This question already holds a reading by that name. Names are unique within one question so a member can ask for a reading by name, and a second one wearing the same name would make every later reference ambiguous.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Only a question carries readings of its evidence, and the thing named here is not a question. There is nothing under it for a suggestion to be a reading of.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This reading of the evidence is the same in substance as one this question already holds, so it is not put forward a second time. The reading it matches is named, and adding a duplicate would grow the review pile without adding anything to review.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This question has no readable file behind it, so there is nothing for a reading of its evidence to be added to. That is a fact about the question rather than about the reading, and nothing was composed.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: Every suggestion names the piece of work that produced it, and this one named none that can be read here. What was searched, under which declared conditions, and where it stopped is what lets anyone else check a reading rather than take it on trust.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: That request did not say which question the suggestion is about. A reading of the evidence always belongs to one question, so it asks rather than guessing.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This suggestion is about a question the investigation was not working on. An investigation is read against its own question, or the questions its project draws on, so work on a different question starts an investigation of that question.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The strength of this reading does not work out over the structure it declares, on one or both of the two things strength is measured on. A reading whose arithmetic cannot be run is a reading nobody can check, and it is not put forward.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The investigation this suggestion names has ended. A suggestion is read against the conditions of the investigation that produced it, and those stopped being current when it stopped, so going on means starting a new one.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This suggestion rests on more pieces of evidence than one reading may carry. The limit is published in the refusal so a caller can split the reading rather than guess at what would have fitted.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A suggestion is one of five kinds and this one names none of them. The kinds are a closed set so that a run reporting an empty search is told apart from a run that reported nothing at all, which no other field can distinguish.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This question's own file could not be extended in place, so nothing was written. Adding a reading edits the record the reading lives in, and a half-written record is worse than an unchanged one.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This suggestion tries to arrive already decided — settled, set aside, hidden, or signed by somebody. A suggestion may only ever arrive as something put forward; deciding what to do with it is a named member's act and no automated caller can reach it.
rows.note: DEC-260: run-productions' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A determination supersedes only an earlier determination of the same act. The one named is about another act. Nothing was written.
rows.note: DEC-260: conformance's translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: This task is not yours to act on: it is with another member now, so nothing was done to it. The record says below who holds it. Ask them, or an administrator, if it still needs you.

rows.en: Name a template or write the words, not both.

rows.en: The template named is written for another kind of action. Name one written for this kind.
rows.note: DEC-260: filings' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The jurisdiction profile holds no file template for this kind: name a template, or write the words.
rows.note: DEC-260: filings' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: filings' translation, keyed by its code

rows.note: DEC-260: filings' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: A finding in this case rests on something the record holds in unresolved conflict, and a case may be published with it only if the conflict is disclosed. Each one is named. One in conflict with a record you cannot see is named by its finding, and the published case will highlight it without naming that record. Disclose it, or resolve it first. Nothing was published.
rows.note: DEC-260: case-disclosures' translation, keyed by its code

rows.en: The text is empty, too long, or not readable as text, so it cannot be prepared or recorded as approved.
rows.note: DEC-260: filings' translation, keyed by its code
